title: Evercreate
body:
# Evercreate
Step into Evercreate, a Create-centered modpack that transforms your Minecraft world into a breathtaking winter wonderland.

This pack focuses on a performance-friendly experience while offering the complex and rewarding gameplay of the Create mod. Forget about heavy, complex tech here (electricity excluded), you'll harness the power of rotational force to build intricate factories, automated farms, and stunning machinery, all nestled in a beautiful, perpetually snowy landscape.

Build, automate, and survive as you establish your own cozy, mechanical haven in the endless snows! Inspired from the [Iron Frost](https://modrinth.com/modpack/iron-frost) series by FyeMir.


<details>
<summary>Lag spikes on chunk loading?</summary>

If you're experiencing lag spikes while loading new chunks, pregenerate them using [/chunky](https://github.com/pop4959/Chunky/wiki) (included in pack)

</details>



---
### Key Features
🏔️ A Snowy World Reimagined: Experience a breathtaking winter wonderland with full terrain generation from **Terralith**, **Tectonic**, and **BloomingNature**, all blanketed in permanent snow.

⚙️ Expanded Create Engineering: Dive into deeper automation with popular Create Addons like **TFMG**, **Integrated Farming**, and more, expanding your mechanical possibilities.

🐟 Tide & Cuisine: Grow extra crops and craft delicious meals with **Farmer's Delight**. A deeper fishing experience with **Tide** and Stardew-style fishing minigame.

🏡 Detailed Building & Decor: Enhance your structures with thousands of new options from **Chipped**, **Handcrafted**, and **Create Copycats+**, perfect for your snowy settlements. Also winter-themed decorations from **Macaw's Holidays**, **Snowy Spirit**, and more. 

🫂 Multiplayer support! **Create: Numismatics, Piggyback** and more. 
<details>
<summary>How to install in a server?</summary>

Server pack is still in the making, make sure you put mods & config folders in your server directory!

</details>



---
